title: Accepted lower band
explanation: 1000 g returns a fee of 300 cents and exact receipt text after the fee reply. The same collaborator objects remain available for the next request.

fields.name: trace
fields.value:
call client -> desk: quote(1000)
call desk -> fees: quote(1000)
return fees -> desk: fee = 300 cents
call desk -> receipts: render(accepted quote)
return receipts -> desk: "Parcel 1000 g: 300 cents"
return desk -> client: accepted result

title: Rejected below the range
explanation: 0 g returns a rejected Quote and Result. The fee and receipt are absent; the receipt object remains unused.

fields.name: trace
fields.value:
call client -> desk: quote(0)
call desk -> fees: quote(0)
return fees -> desk: rejected: Weight must be 1 to 2000 g
return desk -> client: rejected result
